title: AddJobToDbJobs
description: The item process-summary writes to the DynamoDB jobs table to claim a job (a conditional PutItem): a new received job holding its claim lease. Absent values are left out, never written as null. Transcript or summary text is never stored.

job_id.description: Huddle path: the Slack file ID. Manual path: lowercase hex SHA-256 (architecture §6).

channel_id.description: A Slack ID such as a channel, user or file ID.

project_id.description: GitHub Project node ID, if known at claim time.

created_at.description: Unix seconds when the job was claimed.

ttl.description: Unix seconds after which DynamoDB deletes the record.

claimed_at.description: Unix seconds when the process-summary claim lease started.
